concerns.text: Task T002 fails to include the requirement to record checksums of downloaded raw data in the project state YAML, violating Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene): 'Every file under data/ is checksummed in the project's state/...yaml'.

Task T005 is too coarse; it combines the implementation of a new component ('implementing a Markov-chain pseudotime aligner in code/aligner.py') with the execution of a full-scale analysis ('Run the full trajectory reconstruction... for all four datasets').

Task T008 (and T010) produces a final report and summary containing external citations but lacks a verification step for the Reference-Validator Agent, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy).
